Author: Kagekazu
Name: RelicTracker
Punchline: Track relic progress and materials across every job.
Description: Track relic weapon, tool, and armor progress across every job. Requires MogVault for current-character relic detection and material counts across bags, retainers, dresser, and armoire (replicas included). Optional FFXIV Collect sync covers relics you no longer have.
Changelog:
- RelicTracker opens on All Relics, with every weapon, tool, and armour series in one place.
- Pick any upgrade to see a short plan and expand Quest details for the full walkthrough. Armour pages show missing pieces by role or job.
- Materials follows the series you open and groups what's left by how you get it. One-time unlocks have their own section.
- Save Knightshopper lists for eligible materials, missing Dawntrail armour pieces, and supported armour upgrade materials.
- MogVault is required for Materials and live inventory tracking. Existing completion marks still count, and FFXIV Collect can track relics you no longer own.
